required_review_before_geometry_or_colou: Complete archive publisher MD5 and all individual member CRC/SHA verification.
Original DICOM series identity, native sampling, orientation, acquisition and specimen phase; unembedded vs embedded data separate.
Registered NRRD/segmentation grids, original H5 transforms and photograph reconstruction checked without silently replacing native resolution with resampled pitch.
Original PLY format, coordinates, triangles, components, boundaries and source simplification retained and compared with original segmentation.
Every visible source tissue label reviewed; source Sinus Dura label must not imply separately verified venous lumen, wall and dura.
Original photographic colour sampled only inside valid registered image support; source staining/preparation disclosed and unsupported regions not extrapolated or invented.
Every temporal-bone requirement remains pending unless exact source identity, full extent, fidelity and contextual evidence are independently established.
